property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer(...) always returns true when the call completes; the mutant returns false so for some inputs the returned boolean differs (reference always true, mutant can be false).

For any call to transfer with any non-empty _tos array, the reference C always returns true (completes and returns true); the mutant returns false whenever _tos.length > 1, thus violating that the call returns true for multi-recipient inputs.
